Sir, 

On behalf of one of my nationals, I am endeavouring 
to collect an amount of $ 190.76 from a certain 
ifr, Dolgikoff, whose office address was given as 294 Tong- 
shan Road. My registered letter was however returned and | 
enquiries on the spot were equally without result, the ; 
person referred to being unknown at the factory situated 


at 294 Tongshan Road. 


Under the circumstances, I should greatly appreciate 
it, if you could cause some investigations to be made as 
to the existence and whereabouts of Mr.Dolgikoff, so as 
to enable me to reply to the creditor. 


Thanking you in anticipation, 


I have the honour to be, 
Sir, 


Your obedient servant, 


-BEPERAL

Shanghai Municipal Council, 
Shanghai.

File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.D. REGISTRY
S. 2. A.B. 7129
REPORT
Date. December 17, 35.

Subject Communication dated November 30, 1935, from the Swiss Consulate-
General re Dolgikoff, Russian.

Made by D.S. Makaroff Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Enquiries go to show that the individual mentioned
in the communication from the Swiss Consulate-General is
identical with on Nicholas Vladimirovitch Dolgikoff, Russian,
born on November 11, 1902 at Rostov-on-Don.

This Dolgikoff has no fixed abode and the address
given in the attached communication (294 Tongshan Road) was
a fictitious one, as the premises are solely occupied by the
Hsu Chong (瑞康) Chinese Pawn Shop.

N.V. Dolgikoff is at present serving a term of
50 days imprisonment in the French Municipal Gaol on charge of
fraud. **〔此处转录不清〕**

In addition to this offence Dolgikoff's record in
the Finger Print Bureau contains the following convictions:-

1) Issuing worthless cheque - cautioned. 29-12-30. Fr. Police.
2) Fraud. 2 months imprisonment. 6-3-31. ditto.
3) Fraud. Fine $10 or 5 days. 13-6-32. ditto.

N. Makaroff.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

档案编号：警务处
特别处登记室
S. 2. A.B. 7129
报告
日期：1935年12月17日。

事由：瑞士总领事馆1935年11月30日来函，关于俄国人Dolgikoff一事。

由 D.S. Makaroff 呈报 转呈者 **〔此处转录不清〕**

经查询显示，瑞士总领事馆来函中提及之人与Nicholas Vladimirovitch Dolgikoff（俄国人）系同一人，此人于1902年11月11日出生于顿河畔罗斯托夫。

该Dolgikoff无固定住所，附函中所给地址（同山路294号）系虚构，因该处房屋 solely occupied by the Hsu Chong (瑞康) Chinese Pawn Shop（全由瑞康中国当铺占用）。

N.V. Dolgikoff 目前因欺诈罪在法公董局监狱服刑50天。 **〔此处转录不清〕**

除上述罪行外，指纹局存档中Dolgikoff的犯罪记录还包括以下定罪：-

1) 签发空头支票 - 予以警告。1930年12月29日。法国警察。
2) 欺诈。监禁2个月。1931年3月6日。同上。
3) 欺诈。罚款10元或监禁5天。1932年6月13日。同上。

N. Makaroff.
特别处警探。

副督察长（特别处）

CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL DE SUISSE
SHANGHAI
POUR TOUTE LA CHINE

SHANGHAI November 30th 1935.
TELEG. ADR. SWISSCOLAT
A. B. C. 5ÈME & 6ÈME ED.
BENTLEY'S COMPLETE SECOND PHRASE CODE

〔此处转录不清〕

REFERENCE NOTRE G.-XI L.- 306
VOTRE

On est prié de joindre à toute demande l'affranchissement pour la réponse
et de ne traiter qu'un objet par lettre.

Sir,

On behalf of one of my nationals, I am endeavouring
to collect an amount of $ 190.76 from a certain
Mr. Dolgikoff, whose office address was given as 294 Tong-
shan Road. My registered letter was however returned and
enquiries on the spot were equally without result, the
person referred to being unknown at the factory situated
at 294 Tongshan Road.

Under the circumstances, I should greatly appreciate
it, if you could cause some investigations to be made as
to the existence and whereabouts of Mr. Dolgikoff, so as
to enable me to reply to the creditor.

Thanking you in anticipation,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
SWISS CONSUL-GENERAL

To the Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai .
pages.zh:
瑞士驻上海总领事馆
上海
管辖全中国

上海 1935年11月30日。
电报挂号 SWISSCOLAT
A. B. C. 第五版及第六版
BENTLEY'S COMPLETE SECOND PHRASE CODE

〔此处转录不清〕

参考号 我方 G.-XI L.- 306
贵方

请在所有请求中附上回邮资费，且每封信仅处理一件事宜。

先生，

代表我一名国民，我正试图向某位Dolgikoff先生追讨190.76美元款项，其办公地址列为同山路294号。然而，我的挂号信被退回，实地查询亦无结果，同山路294号的工厂内无人知晓此人。

在此情况下，如蒙阁下安排调查Dolgikoff先生是否确有其人及其下落，以便我能回复债权人，我将不胜感激。

预先致谢，

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔签名〕
瑞士总领事

致上海公共租界工部局警务处处长，
上海。
